newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts Yasuda Fire, Mitsui Marine outlook.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Yasuda Fire, Mitsui Marine outlook.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had lowered its rating outlook on Yasuda Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd and Mitsui Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd to negative from stable.
Moody's said in a statement that Yasuda and Mitsui, along with other property and casualty insurers, would face increasing competitive pressure as the insurance industry was deregulated.
Moody's said it planned to issue a special comment shortly outlining major credit concerns related to the deregulation of the Japanese property and casualty insurance industry.
